title: Natural open base change for native derived Weil modules
statement:
Fix a finite field $k_0$, a prime $\ell\ne\operatorname{char}(k_0)$ and $\Omega=\overline{\mathbf Q}_\ell$. Use the native coefficient sheaves $B_{\bar T}$, abelian Weil categories $\mathcal W_T$, their ordinary derived categories $D(\mathcal W_T)$, bounded constructible full subcategories $\mathrm{WC}^{\mathrm{der}}(T)$, and the actual equivariant operations of [def-sf-native-weil-derived-framework]. Let
$$\begin{array}{ccc}U'&\xrightarrow{v}&U\\ j'\downarrow&&\downarrow j\\ T'&\xrightarrow{u}&T\end{array}$$
be a cartesian square [def-weil-pbc-cartesian-square] of locally finite-type $k_0$-schemes [def-weil-finite-type-morphism] and $k_0$-morphisms, with $j$ a quasi-compact open immersion [def-weil-open-immersion], and $u$ arbitrary. Write $J_j$ and $J_{j'}$ for the termwise extensions by zero on ordinary derived categories associated to the native equivariant sheaf extensions by zero. There is a natural isomorphism
$$u^*J_j\ \cong\ J_{j'}v^*:D(\mathcal W_U)\longrightarrow D(\mathcal W_{T'}).$$
The underlying sheaf-level comparison before passage to complexes is the base-change comparison for the localized ringed pro-etale sites with coefficient maps induced by precomposition of locally finite functions. It commutes with the Frobenius comparison maps defining the four native lifts; thus the displayed isomorphism, including its inverse, lies in the native equivariant derived categories. No constructibility or absolute separatedness assumption is imposed.

proof.text: Lift the actual geometric-fibre open adjunction with IsoAlgebra.mapOfNatIsoLeftAdjunction. Its inputs are adicOpenImmersionLowerShriekAdjunction, adicUpperStarLowerStarAdjunction, mateEquiv_adicUpperStarGeometricFiberMapCompFrobeniusIso_inv, and the Frobenius-compatible adicOpenImmersionLowerShriekToLowerStar. The identity adicOpenImmersionLowerShriekAdjunction_unit_app_comp_map_lowerShriekToLowerStar supplies the required inverse-counit normalization. This constructs nativeOpenAdjunction: the specified native extensionByZero is left adjoint to the specified native upperStar, with no change of Frobenius action.

proof.text: Construct nativeOpenBaseChangeMap as the inverse mate of ProEtaleWeilSheaf.lowerStarSquareIso, using the existing native upperStarLowerStarAdjunction for the two open maps. It is already a natural transformation of native fixed-pair categories. Expand the mate component into the unit, the square comparison, and the counit. The source-library formulas lowerStarCompIso_hom_app_hom_f, lowerStarCompIso_inv_app_hom_f, lowerStarCongr_hom_app_hom_f and upperStarLowerStarAdjunction_unit_app_hom_f/counit_app_hom_f show that its carrier is exactly ProEtale.adicBaseChangeMap on the geometric-fibre square. Two elementary congruence identities cancel the congruences introduced by geometricFiberMap_comp. Thus no additional Frobenius equation is assumed.

proof.text: The chosen pullback identification gives IsPullback.of_iso_pullback. Scheme.Hom.isPullback_geometricFiberMap_of_isPullback transports it to the geometric fibres. The existing ProEtale.isIso_adicBaseChangeMap_of_isPullback applies there: it is the module lift of the weakly-etale sheaf base-change theorem, identified on carriers by adicBaseChangeMap_app_hom. Both geometric-fibre open immersions are weakly etale. Applying the exact conservative native carrier to every component therefore proves that nativeOpenBaseChangeMap is invertible. This uses neither properness of the horizontal map nor constructibility of its argument.

proof.text: Compose nativeOpenAdjunction for j with the native pullback/direct-image adjunction for u. Its right adjoint is u_* followed by j^*. Transport this adjunction by the invertible nativeOpenBaseChangeMap to the right adjoint j′^* followed by v_*. This is also the right adjoint of v^* followed by j′_!, by composing the adjunction for v with nativeOpenAdjunction for j′. Mathlib Adjunction.leftAdjointUniq supplies the native natural isomorphism j_! followed by u^* isomorphic to v^* followed by j′_!. This is the same Hom-chain as Stacks 03S6, performed inside the native hearts; both its hom and inverse are fixed-pair morphisms.

proof.text: Native extensionByZero and upperStar are additive and preserve finite limits and finite colimits by their existing source-library instances. Apply Functor.mapDerivedCategoryNatIso to the heart isomorphism, then compose with the inverse Functor.mapDerivedCategoryCompIso on the left and Functor.mapDerivedCategoryCompIso on the right. This proves the unchanged assertion on ordinary unbounded derived categories of all native Weil sheaves. No quasi-compactness of j′, boundedness of the input, constructibility or absolute separatedness was used. The constructed comparison is packaged in the proved private nativeOpenDerivedBaseChangeIso, and the public theorem applies it to the pullback supplied by the chosen Cartesian square.

The proof is the route of Stacks 03S6 (etale-cohomology.tex lemma-shriek-base-change) through 04J0 (sites-modules.tex lemma-localize-morphism-ringed-sites), with the steps written out. Step 1: localize-ringed-site-morphism applied to the pro-etale morphism of sites with V=Ū and u(Ū)≅Ū' by the cartesian square; the weakly-etale localization identifies the slices with Ū_proet and Ū'_proet; I checked that the restricted coefficient map is precomposition for v̄; E is the identity on evaluations, as the cited statement says. Step 2: the ringed-topoi adjunction and the site-restriction adjunction match the framework's tensor-formula pullback and its sheafified extension by zero exactly; I checked the Yoneda construction of a, b and their inverse identities. Step 3: the Frobenius equation follows from mate pasting (1)–(3), with the restriction and direct-image faces commuting on evaluations. It is compressed but concrete, and reading the framework's extension-by-zero comparison as the mate of restriction is the canonical meaning. Step 4: I checked the fixed-pair morphism algebra, for b and for its inverse. Step 5: exactness of the native lifts holds for arbitrary u and both opens, from pullback-exact-lisse, from For being exact and conservative (constructible-abelian), and from the clopen-sheaf comparison. Step 6: the exact-derived natural-iso and composition nodes apply on unbounded D. Edge cases checked: U empty, j = id, u = id, and u with image disjoint from U. The coefficient category is the native framework, not identified with finite coefficients, and it matches the parent's use in compact-base-change. No duplicate: open-proper-interchange is the proper-direction statement, and the cbc and trf open nodes have finite coefficients. No cycle, no SGA. The off-unit uses are generic tools on the unit route or declared in tool_uses; I accept them. No fixes.
